lead: Windows compiles none of a crate's `#[cfg(unix)]` half, so `nv verify` on this host is silent about it
body: — a Unix-only type can be green here and not compile at all. The check is one call, `wsl.exe -- bash -lc 'cd /mnt/<drive>/<repo> && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/var/tmp/nvs-target-wsl cargo test -p <crate>'`, and a second for `cargo clippy -p <crate> --all-targets` because the lints are just as unrun. `mio::net` re-exports no address type at all, so the symmetric-looking `mio::net::SocketAddr` is `E0425` — invisible to every Windows leg.
